title: Finite-Time Characterisation of Acceptance
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input $x$, configuration guard $G$, initial configuration $a$, and proposition $P$. Suppose every computation from $a$ terminates and every live configuration reached before termination satisfies $G$, and suppose $P$ holds exactly when some finite computation from $a$ halts with answer true. Then there is a number $N$ such that every sequence of $N$ choice bits leads to a halted configuration, every live configuration along each such computation before step $N$ satisfies $G$, and $P$ holds exactly when some sequence of $N$ choice bits leads to answer true.
hypotheses_covered: The initial configuration is terminating under G
Acceptance from a is equivalent to P
